definitions: A thermoplastic polymer produced from the monomer ethylene. It is sometimes called "alkathene" or "polythene" when used for pipes.
High-density polyethylene, a polyethylene thermoplastic made from petroleum. It is more rigid and harder than LDPE.
examples: HDPE is known for its high strength-to-density ratio.
Many plastic bottles are made from HDPE.
HDPE is commonly used in the production of plastic bottles, corrosion-resistant piping, and plastic lumber.
